entry.author: Masterton District Council
entry.summary:
To celebrate and support the businesses that make our CBD special, we’re running a Shop & Win competition in collaboration with The Breeze.

Every time you shop at a participating business you’ll go in the draw to win the Queen's Cash - $1,000 to spend in town.

The winner can spend their Queen's Cash across as many participating businesses as they want.

You can enter in-store by writing your name and contact details on the back of your receipt and putting it in the competition box. Every purchase counts as an entry, and there’s no minimum spend required.

The competition opens Monday 4 May and runs until 4 June. The winner will be drawn and notified on 5 June.

https://whatsup.mstn.govt.nz/cdb-upgrade-queen-street-water-main/queens-cash-competition
